topic.title: The free AI year is ending for a whole generation
topic.claim: Everyone who built their entire workday around free ChatGPT and free Perplexity is about to find out what their own thinking costs per month.
topic.behaviour: OpenAI's free one-year ChatGPT Go plan (started November 2025) and Airtel's bundled free Perplexity Pro, worth roughly Rs 17,000 a year and running July 2026 to January 2027, are both approaching expiry. Perplexity reverts to about Rs 1,417 a month once the free period ends. Google has responded with a free one-year AI Pro plan for Indian students.
topic.mechanism: This is the oldest India playbook there is, give it away free until it's a habit, then start charging, the same way Jio and the early cab apps did it. The difference is this time it's not a service, it's become how people write, study and work.
topic.group: 22-38 year olds who built their college or office workflow on free AI tools
real_details: ChatGPT Go free plan started November 2025
Airtel's free Perplexity Pro worth ~Rs 17,000/year, running July 2026 to January 2027
Perplexity reverts to ~Rs 1,417/month after the free period
Google offering a free one-year AI Pro plan for Indian students
topic.news_peg: DQ India report on expiring free AI plans, October 19, 2026
topic.why_now: Renewal decisions are happening right now as the windows close

score.why: Most AI at work is already busywork theatre, and this is the month the free ride ends so people find out what their own thinking costs.

paragraphs: Everyone built their workday around free ChatGPT and Claude. This month, ChatGPT's free year ends and Rs 399 a month starts. Who's ready?
Swipe to read →
The free year was never a gift. It's the first half of a very old plan.
The numbers are already set. You just haven't looked at the second half yet.
ChatGPT Go was free for a year from November 2025. Around November 2026, the auto-billing quietly starts at Rs 399 a month.
Nobody circled that date on a calendar. The app already did.
And the free plan on Claude was never meant to be the plan.
It's there so you hit the limit in the middle of a deadline. Then you upgrade without thinking twice.
You know exactly who I mean.
The analyst who hasn't written a cold email from scratch in a year. The student whose every assignment opens in a chat box.
The bill just hasn't landed yet.
This is the oldest playbook in India.
Give something away until a whole country builds its day around it. Let the habit set. Then put a price on it.
The free part is never the business.
But the usual version of this was a service. You could downgrade the plan. You could take the bus.
This one is different. It stopped being a thing you use.
It's how you write, study and work now.
Walking away doesn't mean cancelling an app. It means relearning how to do your own job without the thing that's been doing half of it.
The next hook is out. Google is giving Indian students a free year of its AI Pro plan. It catches them while they're broke and forming the habit.
None of this was about the price. It was about renting your thinking by the month.

hook_candidates: Everyone built their workday around free ChatGPT. Next November it starts charging Rs 399 a month, on its own. Who's ready for that bill?
A year ago ChatGPT Go cost you nothing. Around next November it quietly bills Rs 399 a month. Who decided that for you?
The analyst hasn't written a cold email from scratch in a year. Soon she pays Rs 399 a month to keep not writing them. Why?
Google is handing Indian students a free year of its AI. Nobody gives a whole country something for free. So what are they buying?
Your free ChatGPT year ends next November. Then Rs 399 a month starts on its own. Did anyone actually plan for that?

sources.fact: DQ India reports that ChatGPT Go's free year in India ends around November 2026, after which auto-billing at the regular monthly price kicks in.
sources.excerpt: OpenAI offers ChatGPT Go (previously Rs.399/month) free to any Indian user who signs up between November 4, 2025 ... Jio, Airtel and OpenAI are offering free access to Gemini Pro, Perplexity Pro and ChatGPT Go, accelerating AI adoption for Indian creators, students and professionals. These temporary promotions of Jio, Airtel, and OpenAI make the advanced models available at thousands of rupees... 'Set a reminder' for November 2026, as auto-billing at ₹399/month begins when your 12 months end — around November 2026. Airtel prepaid/ post paid, Wi-Fi, and DTH users receive Airtel prepaid/postpaid 12 months Perplexity Pro (Rs17,000 value) on Airtel Thanks app no strings attached. (Updated 8 September 2026; originally published 02 Jan 2026 11:10 IST)

sources.fact: OpenAI made its ChatGPT Go plan (normally under $5/month, i.e. Rs 399) free for one year to all users in India starting November 4, 2025.
sources.excerpt: OpenAI said Monday that it is offering ChatGPT Go, its cheapest subscription plan, for free in India for one year ... Priced at less than $5 per month ... users in India who sign up during a limited promotional period ... starting November 4 ... free of charge for one year ... Existing ChatGPT Go subscribers in India will also be eligible for the free 12-month plan.

sources.fact: Airtel bundled a complimentary 12-month Perplexity Pro subscription, normally worth about Rs 17,000 a year, for its prepaid, postpaid, Wi-Fi and DTH customers.
sources.excerpt: Airtel prepaid/ post paid, Wi-Fi, and DTH users receive Airtel prepaid/postpaid 12 months Perplexity Pro (Rs17,000 value) on Airtel Thanks app no strings attached ... normally priced at ₹17,000 ... complimentary 1-year subscription ... 1 year of complimentary Perplexity Pro access. Start date: September 22, 2025. End date: May 21, 2026. (Offer details and eligibility criteria mentioned here are based on information available as of July 2025.)
